_comment: Pinned versions for the business-de skills. Re-verify on every spec/validator bump; record the re-verification date in the skill's references/SOURCES.md. Never hardcode a version inside scripts or SKILL.md - read it from this file.

en16931.note: EN 16931-1:2017 with Corrigendum 2017-06 (v1.2.4). Factur-X 2.5.2 already back-ports features from EN 16931-1:2026 (in progress, not yet published by CEN). Re-verify against the CEN standard page when EN 16931-1:2026 ships.

factur-x.note: FeRD + FNFE-MPE joint release 2026-08-04: ZUGFeRD 2.5.2 / Factur-X 1.09.2. 2.5.2 is a corrigendum cleaning up inconsistencies in a new EXTENDED-profile functionality carried over from the upcoming EN 16931-1:2026. Next release expected autumn 2026 (gross invoices + further EN 16931-1:2026 features). UPGRADED 2026-10-13 from the previously pinned 1.0.11 (akretion/factur-x), which is now superseded. The EN 16931 base version stays 1.2.4 until EN 16931-1:2026 is published by CEN; re-verify then.

kosit-validator.note: KoReSIT/itplr-kosit validator configuration (tag v2026-08-31, repo pushed 2026-09-04). Fallback: john-wink/en16931-php v0.2.0 (274/274 rules). Re-verify on release.

ustg_obligation.note: e-invoicing obligation for B2B in Germany. Re-verify against BMF Schreiben of 2024-11-15 before relying on transitional rules.

beg_iv.note: Retention classes: vouchers 8y, books/annual accounts 10y, commercial correspondence 6y. Verified 2026-10-08 against AO §147 Abs. 3 n.F. (effective 2025-01-01) via steuer-berater.de and whk-controlling.de. The BEG statute text itself 404'd at retrieval; the classes are now corroborated by AO §147, so treat as verified. Let the tax advisor confirm per entity.

gobd_2014.note: Superseded GoBD principles retained for older retention periods. Re-verify against BMF Schreiben of 2024-11-15.

ao147.note: Retention classes confirmed by steuer-berater.de lexikon (2025-12-03): 10y Bücher/Jahresabschlüsse, 8y Buchungsbelege, 6y andere Unterlagen/Geschäftsbriefe. Corroborated by whk-controlling.de (modified 2026-04-14) and R3_VERIFIED_FACTS.md. The gesetze-im-internet.de AO page 404'd at retrieval; re-fetch before audit.

extf_schema.note: EXTF Versionsnummer=700, Formatversion=13 for Buchungsstapel (125 columns). Formatversion 10-12 are warnings; 13 is the current. EXTF_AS_OF 2026-09-25 per the seamless-engineering validator. DATEV does not publish a public version page; mark as unverified until DATEV confirms via the Prüfprogramm. Re-verify on every integration test run.

extf_formatkennzeichen.note: Field 1 of the header. DTVF is the legacy alternative.

kontenrahmen.note: Pinned default Kontenrahmen for Ottili GmbH. SKR03 is the alternative for GmbH & Co. KG. Re-verify against DATEV/IDR before each build; the account list is stable, the tax keys are not.

ust_rates_2026.note: Rates valid for 2026. EU ViDA may change them from 2027-01-01 (secondary source, verify). Read from this file; never hardcode in scripts.

am_konten.note: Automatikkonten per SKR; EXTF_AS_OF 2026-09-25. A BU-Schluessel other than '40' on these is rejected or double-counted by DATEV.

kleinunternehmer_threshold.note: Turnover threshold for the previous calendar year. Re-verify before each build; unchanged for years.

reverse_charge.note: Schuldnerschaft for intra-community services (IT, consulting, construction). The buyer bears the VAT debt; the buyer's USt-IdNr. is mandatory. §3g is services only — a goods supply with a buyer USt-IdNr. uses §4a, not reverse charge.

oss.note: OSS for EU distance sales of goods and services. EU ViDA changes planned from 2027-01-01 (secondary source, verify).

rounding.note: Highest-error-rate area in German VAT. Never round the total before the tax split.

camt053_version.note: Current namespace is camt.053.001.08 (corroborated by de.wikipedia Camt-Format, 2026-10-09). Version 14 expected ~2026-09; re-verify before each build.

mt940_version.note: No public version page; mark as unverified until SWIFT confirms.

iban_rules.note: German IBANs use a country-specific check-digit algorithm, not generic mod-97.

duplicate_rule.note: Strict primary definition; a 5-day amount+reference window is a configurable heuristic, disabled by default.

_recheck_2026_10_09.method: curl -L --max-time 45 with OttiliResearchBot/1.0 UA; GitHub API for repo/tag availability
_recheck_2026_10_09.detail: Every version-sensitive URL in this file was re-fetched. gesetze-im-internet.de/ao/ and /uStg/ now 404 (site layout changed); BEG /beg/ 200. iso20022.org and swift.com 403 (access-restricted). steuer-berater.de/lexikon/ao-147/ 404 (entry moved; lexikon root 200). All GitHub repos (seamless-engineering/datev-extf, akretion/factur-x, itplr-kosit/validator-configuration-xrechnung) 200. de.wikipedia Camt-Format, IBAN, UStG 200. No pinned version changed; the two statute portals are the weak links - re-fetch before audit.

_recheck_2026_10_13.method: curl -L --max-time 45 with OttiliResearchBot/1.0 UA; GitHub API for repo/tag availability
_recheck_2026_10_13.detail: FeRD news page https://www.ferd-net.de/aktuelles-veranstaltungen/aktuelles/news/zugferd-252-veroeffentlicht returned 200 and confirms ZUGFeRD 2.5.2 / Factur-X 1.09.2 published 2026-08-04. KoSIT validator-configuration-xrechnung CHANGELOG (master) confirms the v2026-08-31 tag is compatible with XRechnung 3.0, uses CEN Schematron 1.3.16 and KoSIT Validator v1.6.3. agentskills.io/specification 200. steuer-berater.de/lexikon/gobd 200 (cookie-wall JS only, body text not rendered without consent - content corroborated from the 2026-10-08 pass). No other pinned version changed.

webhooks-safe.note: Stripe signature window (t= timestamp, must be within 5 minutes). GitHub/Meta use sha256 HMAC with no timestamp. Re-verify against provider docs on every SDK bump.

dhl_rest.note: DHL Parcel DE REST API. The live developer.dhl.com page (200 OK, 2026-10-14) states the API version is v2.0.2 (response field
). The earlier 2.2.0 pin was wrong - it was read from a test-environment page. DPD/GLS/Hermes/UPS are unverified until the partner portals are reachable.

carrier-apis-de.note: The old Geschaeftskundenversand SOAP API v2 was decommissioned 2026-05-31; use the REST API.

publish-reconcile-wp-meta.note: Meta Graph API version moves quarterly; re-verify each quarter.

dsgvo-ai-act-labeling.note: Art. 50(2) marking date is a secondary-source date (Digital Omnibus); re-verify against the recital before relying on it.
